svg.title: Image indices and physical triangular mesh
svg.desc: Original 28 by 36 synthetic intensity image with threshold 0.5 contour, beside its actual conforming triangular mesh. Spacing is 1.25 mm per column and 2 mm per row; origin is (-20,-10) mm and orientation is a 20 degree proper rotation. No flow equation is solved.
